review_findings_dispositions.MINOR-2_compute_env_cpu_identity: FIXED + test + mutant. compute_env pins _host_cpu_identity() (llvmlite host CPU name + /proc/cpuinfo model, OSError-safe, module-level monkeypatchable); geometry_env deliberately unchanged. INCIDENT (reproduced, explained, probe-fixed; no library change): an early probe8 draft wiped CACHE_DIR between legs while stage_cache_for's process registry still held a live store constructed during a previous leg's stats() call. The store's __init__ (which creates store/locks/tmp/quarantine) never re-runs, put() lazily recreates only its own store/+tmp/ subtrees, so the next single-flight os.link into locks/ failed FileNotFoundError. This is exactly the documented CACHE_STORE NOTE-6 contract: an uncoordinated directory removal racing a live store fails LOUDLY (OSError family) instead of serving wrong data. Verified with syscall tracing (no internal deleter; locks/ inode transitioned to absent) and 3/3 deterministic reproduction on two filesystems. Probe fixed to never wipe the root under a live registry; HANDOFF to INTEGRATE/CACHE_STORE: consider a cheap locks/-existence ensure (or an explicit invalidate-registry-on-root-loss) before _acquire_file_lock if operator workflows wipe cache roots under running processes.
